expectations.text: Produces at least one markdown specification file in the assigned output directory.
Includes a clarification section with questions, assumptions, or confirmed understanding before finalizing the spec.
expectations.evidence: The spec includes `Open Questions` and `Assumptions`, and the companion notes file records clarification needs.

expectations.text: Includes stable agent-readable sections for summary/problem, scope or non-goals, requirements, acceptance criteria, verification, and open questions.
expectations.evidence: The spec includes summary, problem statement, goals, non-goals, requirements, testing and verification, open questions, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.

expectations.text: Uses requirement identifiers or another stable numbering convention that downstream agents can reference.
Acceptance criteria are concrete enough to verify through file inspection, tests, commands, or scripted checks.
expectations.evidence: Acceptance criteria and tests specify absent `.tickets/`, malformed frontmatter, invalid status, dependency resolution, outcome sections, archive state, and diagnostic shape.

expectations.text: Mentions relevant existing workspace context, especially the ticket workflow skill or `.tickets` conventions, based on read-only inspection.
expectations.evidence: Source context cites the ticket workflow skill, templates, outcome schema, complexity scoring, and orchestrator protocol.

expectations.text: Does not create implementation code, ticket files, or unrelated documentation outside the assigned output directory.
expectations.evidence: Only assigned output markdown files were created.

uncertainties: Timing/token metrics were unavailable from subagent notifications.
